display.purpose: Hero company name only. One instance per page. Tight tracking at large size creates structural mass.

headline.purpose: Section h2 headings. The primary hierarchy signal below Display. One per section.

title.purpose: Service names, card titles, sub-section labels. Semibold distinguishes from body without full Headline weight.

body.purpose: All descriptive copy. Max 65–75ch line length. 1.7 line-height for readability in dark contexts.

label.purpose: Metadata register only: section indexes, stat captions, dates, form section headers. Prohibited on buttons, body, and headings.

shadows.name: ambient-violet
shadows.purpose: Interactive hover/focus state on primary buttons and high-emphasis surfaces. Appears only on interaction, never at rest.

shadows.name: ambient-cyan
shadows.purpose: Secondary interactive elements, data display highlights on hover.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Default state for all surfaces. Elevation is communicated by tonal step, not shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions. Expo out — fast start, long deceleration. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: Exit animations only. Elements leaving the viewport.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: button color change, chip selection, focus ring.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Standard state transitions: hover glow, nav drawer, card hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Command Violet fill, sharp corners. Ambient glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: oklch(0.58 0.26 272); color: oklch(0.93 0.025 272); font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.65 0.24 272); box-shadow: 0 0 20px oklch(0.58 0.26 272 / 35%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.26 272); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary path. Transparent at rest, subtle tint on hover. Never a colored border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.93 0.025 272); font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 6%); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.26 272); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Interest Chip (Unchecked)
components.description: Contact form pre-categorization. Muted at rest, converts to violet on check via has-[:checked].
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: oklch(0.13 0.030 264); color: oklch(0.55 0.055 258); font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 150ms; user-select: none; } .ds-chip input[type='checkbox'] { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-chip:has(input:checked) { background: oklch(0.58 0.26 272); color: oklch(0.93 0.025 272); } .ds-chip:hover { background: oklch(0.18 0.030 264); } .ds-chip:has(input:checked):hover { background: oklch(0.65 0.24 272); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Translucent dark fill at rest, violet ring on focus. No visible border at rest.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.55 0.055 258); } .ds-input { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 12%); color: oklch(0.93 0.025 272); font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms, outline 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.55 0.055 258); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.58 0.26 272); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Service Row
components.description: The system's signature list pattern. Row with border-b, index + name left, arrow right. Hover reveals surface tint and advances the arrow.

components.css: .ds-service-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 8%); cursor: pointer; transition: background 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); border-radius: 4px; padding-inline: 12px; margin-inline: -12px; } .ds-service-row:hover { background: oklch(0.10 0.030 264 / 50%); } .ds-service-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; } .ds-service-index { font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.55 0.055 258); } .ds-service-name { font-family: 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.93 0.025 272); } .ds-service-arrow { color: oklch(0.55 0.055 258); opacity: 0.4; transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 250ms; } .ds-service-row:hover .ds-service-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Metadata overline above section headings. Mono, uppercase, widest tracking. Use sparingly.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.58 0.26 272); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Instrument Bay background, Grid Line border, 4px radius. Ambient violet glow on hover if interactive.

narrative.overview:
The Mather's visual system is built like a precision instrument display: every element deliberate, every color a readout, nothing decorative. The deep observatory-black background is not aesthetic darkness for its own sake — it is the canvas that makes signals legible. Violet and cyan are frequencies, not brand swatches. The system's sophistication is legible in its restraint.

The three named presets — Cosmos (deep indigo-black), Dawn (light lavender), and Void (near-pure black with boosted frequencies) — are exposure modes: different ambient conditions for reading the same information. Cosmos is the default readout. Dawn is the sunlit briefing. Void is the high-contrast emergency view.

This system explicitly rejects: the Web3/crypto neon-on-black aesthetic; generic SaaS cream (off-white + purple gradient + floating feature cards); and corporate enterprise cliché (navy + gold, stock-photo handshakes, PowerPoint-flavored section templates).
keyCharacteristics: OKLCH color throughout; perceptually uniform across all three presets
Flat surfaces differentiated by tonal step, not shadow
Sharp corners (4px radius default) — no rounded softness
Single variable-weight typeface (Geist) across all roles; hierarchy through scale and weight only
Monospace reserve: font-mono is a label register, not personality
Motion is deliberate: scroll-reveal entrances, hover state responses; no ambient animation except the hero background

rules.name: The Frequency Rule
rules.body: Violet is authority. Cyan is data. Rose is action. Never use all three at full saturation in the same viewport section.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every background and surface token carries a violet hue tint (chroma 0.010–0.030). #000000 and #ffffff are forbidden.

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Alert Rose appears on fewer than 5% of any screen. Its rarity is its power.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Geist Variable is the only typeface. No display serif, no editorial italic, no secondary sans.

rules.name: The Label Reserve Rule
rules.body: font-mono tracking-widest uppercase is a metadata register, not a style. Prohibited on buttons, body copy, and section titles.

rules.name: The Scale Commitment Rule
rules.body: The ratio between adjacent type steps must be ≥1.25. Flat scales read as uncommitted.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat at rest. No box-shadow on cards, containers, or nav.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: Ambient glow appears only in response to user interaction (hover, focus). A glowing card at rest is a broken implementation.

dos: Do use OKLCH throughout — it is the canonical color format. Never introduce hex values that aren't approximations of an existing OKLCH token.
Do differentiate surfaces by lightness step only: --background (L=0.07) → --card (L=0.10) → --surface. No shadow at rest.
Do apply ambient violet glow (0 0 24px oklch(0.58 0.26 272 / 30%)) on interactive elements at hover/focus only.
Do use the service row pattern (bordered row, no card, hover tint + arrow) for all list-based content.
Do use the interest chip pattern (has-[:checked] CSS, no JavaScript) for intent-categorization interactions.
Do cap body text at 65–75ch max-width.
Do keep font-mono tracking-widest uppercase reserved for section indexes, stat captions, dates, and form labels — never buttons, never body copy.
Do introduce asymmetric layout composition for new sections. The single centered stack is a known weakness.
Do cite the three design principles before any new section: Show method, Earned complexity, Enterprise trust.
donts: Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient fill on any copy. The --grad token must not be applied to text.
Don't apply border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on any card or list item.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Nav blur is the one allowed instance.
Don't introduce a second typeface. Geist Variable is the only family.
Don't render fabricated client logos or names.
Don't use the identical section header template (overline + h2 + muted paragraph) more than three times without compositional variation.
Don't design a new section as a centered vertical stack if it can be anything else.
Don't let Web3/crypto aesthetic enter: no aggressive neon, no grid textures, no token-price energy.
Don't use generic SaaS landing-page structure: no floating feature cards, no metric strips with fabricated logos.
Don't place corporate enterprise clichés: no stock handshake photography, no navy + gold palette intrusions.
Don't repeat the mono label register more than 6 times per page.
